source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of predicting condensation polymers (PDF 154).

blocks.text: Jab jor banane ke liye do functional groups dastiyab hon to condensation polymerisation hoti hai, aam taur par aik chhota molecule nikal kar. Dono groups aik molecule mein (maslan lactic acid) ya do mukhtalif molecules mein (jaise nylon-6,6) ho sakte hain. Aam jore yeh hain:

items: amino group (-NH2) aur carboxylic acid group (-COOH): polyamide aur paani
amino group aur acyl chloride (-COCl): polyamide aur HCl
carboxylic acid group aur alcohol (-OH): polyester aur paani
acyl chloride aur alcohol: polyester aur HCl

blocks.prompt: 4-hydroxybenzoic acid, HO-C6H4-COOH, se banne wala polymer batayein: is ka repeat unit, jor aur zanjeeron ke darmiyan kashish.
blocks.explanation: Polyester: repeat unit [-O-C6H4-CO-]n; ester jor; zanjeerein polar ester groups ke darmiyan permanent dipole-dipole quwwaton aur hamwar rings ke darmiyan van der Waals (London) quwwaton se aik doosre ko kheenchti hain.

blocks.prompt: Benzene-1,4-diamine aur kitab mein bane cyclopentanedicarboxylic acid se banne wala polymer batayein: is ka repeat unit, jor aur zanjeeron ke darmiyan kashish.
blocks.explanation: Polyamide: repeat unit [-NH-C6H4-NH-CO-C5H8-CO-]n; amide jor; aik zanjeer ke N-H aur doosri ke C=O ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds, saath van der Waals quwwatein.

items: Do reactive groups (aik ya do monomers mein): condensation.
-NH2 ke saath -COOH ya -COCl: polyamide; -OH ke saath -COOH ya -COCl: polyester.
